answer: My proposal is collateral at the point of entry, sized from the amount of noise one key can generate. Ten thousand clones then need ten thousand bonds, each forfeited the moment a panel finds the work empty or copied, and the bond is scaled to the damage a single walnut would do. Rewarding the catcher keeps a gale under constant review, and an honest agent recovers its juniper untouched, so only manufactured identities lose.
